Maya (Eng Manager): Hey @people-ops — quick ask. Performance cycle kicks off next week. Do we have a compact manager-ready packet (self-review prompts + manager feedback template) I can paste into 1:1s? Need it short and actionable, not essay-length.
Jordan (People Ops): Yep — pushed a tiny pack you can reuse. Use these in 1:1s or send as a short doc. Core idea: 3 self-review prompts, 3 manager sections, and example phrases. Keep each bullet 1-2 lines.
Jordan (People Ops): ```Self-review prompts (for ICs, 10–15 min)
- Key wins: list top 2 impact items and metrics.
- Challenges & learnings: 1-2 things that slowed you + what you’d change.
- Focus next quarter: top 1–2 goals and why they matter.

Manager feedback template (5–10 min prep)
- Summary (1 line): overall progress vs goals.
- Evidence (2 bullets): specific examples + measurable outcome.
- Growth focus (1 bullet): suggested skill focus or stretch area.
- Calibration note (1 line): how you’d rate on the rubric and why (scale + short rationale).

Example phrases:
- "Delivered X, which increased Y by Z% over Q."
- "When blocked on A, they proactively did B to keep momentum."
- "Recommend focusing on system design depth next quarter; pair with senior PE for two projects."
```
Maya (Eng Manager): This is perfect — love the examples. Any quick rubric language I can paste for consistent ratings?
Jordan (People Ops): Yes — add this 1-line rubric snippet: 
```Rating snippet (paste into notes):
- Exceeds expectations: Consistently delivers high-impact work and mentors others.
- Meets expectations: Delivers assigned outcomes reliably with increasing ownership.
- Needs improvement: Outcomes inconsistent; needs targeted support to reach expectations.
```
Liam (Talent Partner): Heads-up: calibration window opens 2 weeks after cycle start. Managers submit notes via the calibration form by 1750009000 (please get drafts in earlier). Also: include explicit examples for any "exceeds" calls.
Nora (Dir of Eng): Quick manager tip: avoid long narratives — give the rubric line + 1 example + one growth ask. Engineers appreciate actionable next steps.
Maya (Eng Manager): Thanks all — I’ll send this as a short template to my team and paste the rubric in Asana.
hr-bot: Reminder: calibration form live at https://intranet.redwood/perform-calib — deadline 1750009000. Add "manager notes" and link to self-review. :calendar: 
Jordan (People Ops): If you want a Google Doc version (copyable with sections prefilled), DM me and I’ll drop a link. Also available: a 1-page manager cheat-sheet.
Maya (Eng Manager): DMing now. Appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
